ZLA Sector 14 (West Flow).description:
Sector 14 is a low altitude sector involving numerous climbing and descending aircraft in the general vicinty of VTU. Sector 14 is bounded to the west by an assortment of special use airspace areas whose status is subject to constant change depending on the needs of the military. 
 
Sector 14 works aircraft departing KLAX and KLGB airports to the west and northwest. Sector 14 also works east and southeast bound departures from KSBA and arrivals to KSBA from these directions. KLAX arrivals from over the ocean, KLGB and KSNA arrivals are also a large part of Sector 14's traffic. Sector 14 must always be aware of the flow restrictions to Bay Area airports and do as much as possible to help sequence these aircraft.

ZLA Sector 13 (West Flow).description:
Sector 13 is the primary arrival sector for air carriers inbound to KLAX,KBUR,KVNY and KSMO from the northwest. Sector 13 also sequences aircraft en-route to KLGB,KSNA and KCRQ that are cleared over the vicinty of FIM and FLW. 

Sector 13 is a very narrow sector, about 28 miles at its widest point. Speed control and vectors must be used to achieve the required spacing. Sector 13 cannot vector very far off course without first obtaining permission from surrounding sectors. It is imperative that point outs and control for vectors are made/obtained from proper sectors.

ZLA Sector 15 (West Flow).description:
Sector 15 overlies SBA TRACON and Oakland Air Route Traffic Control Center (ZOA) airspace. Most of Sector 15's traffic is arrival and departure aircraft from SBA TRACON. 

Over-flight traffic between ZOA sectors to the north (ZOA Sector 10, FL190 and below; ZOA Sector 14, FL200 and above; ZOA Sector 11, FL200-270), ZLA Sectors 03, 13, 14, BFL TRACON and Naval Air Station (NAS) Lemoore RATCF to the east and northeast make up the bulk of the remainder of the traffic in the sector. 

Sectors 25 and 26 overly Sector 15 and is bound by Sector 28/W-532 on the west. The offshore arrival route for air carriers landing KLGB and KSAN runs along the western edge of Sector 15 and includes the area of R-2534A/B and R-2516 at and above FL180.

ZLA Sector 13/15 Combined (West Flow).description: See individual descriptions for Sectors 13 and 15 for traffic variety and conflict points.
